title: Hierarchical Bio-Mineral and Cross-Linked Dermal Armor Resistance
test: Quantify sharp puncture and blade cutting resistance of layered osteoderm-collagen-adipose composites vs human skin
description: A composite integument of mineralized osteoderms and high-density cross-linked collagen increases cut and puncture resistance by >5x over human baseline.

title: Acoustic Impedance Mismatch in Biological Multilayers for Shock Wave Attenuation
test: Measure high-frequency compressive stress pulse transmission through alternating mineral-gel-collagen layers vs monolithic bone
description: Alternating high-impedance biomineral tiles with low-impedance viscoelastic interlayers attenuates shock wave amplitude by >90% via interface reflections and Cook-Gordon crack blunting.

title: Reactive Sensorimotor Evasion of Supersonic Ballistic Projectiles (Bullet Dodging)
test: Compare projectile flight time at combat distances (7-50m) against minimal theoretical biological sensorimotor latency and motor acceleration
description: Reactive dodging of an incoming high-speed bullet is physically impossible for an organism constrained by chemical synapses and biological mass.

title: Behind-Armor Blunt Trauma and Thoracic Viscous Deceleration Thresholds
test: Evaluate thoracic backface deformation (BFD) and Viscous Criterion (VC) under non-penetrating ballistic impacts with varied skeletal bridging
description: Stopping bullet penetration does not prevent lethal trauma; surviving ballistic impact requires rigid skeletal load dispersion over >= 120 mm diameter to keep VC < 0.6 m/s and BFD < 25 mm.

title: Rapid Local Hemostasis in Dermal and Muscular Vasculature
test: Simulate vascular spasm and accelerated clot formation under arterial pressures in medium muscular arteries
description: Engineered local hemostatic sealants accelerate clotting from 180s to <30s, capping blood loss in medium muscular artery transections to <3% (Class I shock).

title: Chemical Clot-Mediated Sealing of Major Conduit Arteries (Aorta/Femoral)
test: Model high-shear orifice flow and platelet plug wash-away in transected aorta and femoral arteries
description: Chemical hemostasis cannot arrest major conduit arterial transection; high wall shear stress (>40 Pa) dislodges clots, leading to lethal Class IV exsanguination in <120s.

title: Mammalian Epimorphic Regeneration Coupled with Peto-Scale Tumor Suppression
test: Model multi-scale tissue recovery times and Armitage-Doll multi-stage oncogenic hazard under hyper-proliferative blastema conditions
description: Acomys-like scarless healing is viable in mammals, but whole-limb epimorphic regeneration requires 10-20x TP53 tumor suppressor duplication to prevent catastrophic malignancy.

title: Integrated Zoned Bio-Armor Architecture Resolving the Thermoregulatory Bottleneck
test: Whole-organism multi-criteria optimization balancing mass, 9mm ballistic protection, sprint mobility, and thermal heat dissipation
description: Zoned armor (55% vital area coverage) is hypothesized to balance 9mm ballistic protection with thermoregulation, but remains an unvalidated top-level conceptual hypothesis (ARCH-4 = UNVALIDATED) requiring experimental verification of skeletal bridging, spall suppression, and multi-tier oncogenic stability.

title: Universal Puncture Resistance Ceiling for Unmineralized Dermal Composites
test: Evaluate sharp needle indentation (r <= 0.1 mm) across collagenous and hydrogel tissues vs biomineral plates
description: All unmineralized soft tissues (human skin, collagen cross-linked hydrogels) are penetrated by sharp blades and needles (r <= 0.1 mm) at forces under 35 N due to Mode-I crack propagation. High puncture resistance (>100 N) strictly requires hard mineral or dense keratinized crystalline plates.

title: Decoupled Multi-Scale Biological Regeneration Across Acute and Functional Timelines
test: Simulate 6 coupled phases of tissue regeneration across 365 days under clinical trauma defect tiers
description: Regeneration operates on strictly decoupled biological timescales: hemostasis occurs in hours, vascularization in 4-8 days, and dermal re-epithelialization in 1-2 weeks. However, skeletal muscle volumetric defects (>5 mm gap) and peripheral nerve re-innervation (capped at 1.0-2.0 mm/day by tubulin SCa transport) mandate months for recovery, refuting instantaneous combat self-repair.

title: Cutaneous Evaporative Cooling Collapse in Heavy Biological Armor
test: Simulate 2700-second combat performance endurance protocol across temperate, hot-dry, and hot-humid climates
description: Extensive cutaneous armor coverage (>70%) severely restricts evaporative cooling, inducing fatal hyperthermic core temperature increases (+5.3 K, exceeding 39.5°C in ~20 minutes) during sustained physical activity in warm environments.

title: Pareto Dominance of Functionally Graded Selective Plating over Uniform Viscoelastic Coatings
test: Perform multi-objective non-dominated sorting across ARCH-0 to ARCH-4 over 6 standardized criteria groups
description: Functionally graded selective plating (ARCH-4) Pareto-dominates uniform flexible viscoelastic composites (ARCH-2) by delivering 2.4x higher puncture protection with 38% less parasitic mass, 33% higher heat dissipation, and superior sprint retention.

title: Chemical membrane fusogens (PEG-fusion) bypass slow axonal transport for rapid neurotization
test: Simulate 8-axis functional recovery comparing PEG membrane fusion vs unassisted spontaneous elongation
description: Application of polyethylene glycol (PEG) immediately post-severance salvages >70% of motor and sensory axolemmas, preventing Wallerian degeneration and restoring motor conduction within 7 days instead of months.

title: Internal biohybrid subdermal micro-armor decouples protection from cutaneous evaporative cooling
test: Integrate subdermal micro-armor in 2700-second CPE45 thermodynamic protocol across 3 climate zones
description: Placing articulated high-toughness micro-tiles in the subdermal fascial plane limits epidermal sweat gland occlusion to <10%, preventing hyperthermic collapse during the 2700-second CPE45 endurance protocol across temperate and hot-dry climates.

title: Endogenous selective FGM and keratin scales achieve slash and puncture protection within human locomotor mass budget
test: Quantify mass penalty, flexural stiffness, and cutting/puncture resistance in Muscle Architecture A
description: A selective 4.2 kg endogenous dermal composite combining pangolin-like keratin scales and continuous FGM sternal bridges elevates puncture resistance to >160 N and slash resistance to >650 N while preserving >90% sprint speed and acceleration in Muscle Architecture A.

title: Chemical Axonal Fusogen Disconnect between Electrophysiological Conduction and Motor Force
test: Compare compound nerve action potential (CNAP) restoration with long-term isometric muscle force and synkinesis rate
description: PEG-fusion restores immediate axolemmal integrity and action potential transmission (65-85%), but functional contractile torque is delayed and limited to 45-65% at 1 year due to 35-50% motor axonal misdirection and terminal synaptic remodeling.

title: Clinical Ceiling of Extracellular Matrix Bioscaffolds in Human Volumetric Muscle Loss
test: Audit 13-patient clinical cohort and pre-clinical data separating volumetric defect mass from peak contractile torque vs intact limb
description: Acellular ECM scaffolds in human VML (>15-20% muscle volume loss) provide structural filling and +25-38% strength gains over pre-operative deficit, but persistent fibrotic scarring and vascular diffusion limits preclude return to uninjured baseline strength.

title: Empirical External Validation Gate for Native Biomaterials, Human VML, and ISO 7933 Thermoregulation
statement: Biological architecture models for native tissues (dermis, keratin, osteoderm) and human VML achieve external validation with mean relative error <15% against published empirical cohorts, whereas speculative materials and live ballistic resistance exhibit epistemic uncertainty that must remain classified as exploratory numerical assumptions.

title: Forensic Model Realism & Partial Validation Boundaries
statement: When clinical individual participant data and derived physical predictions are evaluated without circular calibration or synthetic data, models exhibit bounded predictive utility (VML MAE ~ 25.7%, Materials error ~ 9.2%, Thermal rate error ~ 0.01 K/min), requiring strict PARTIAL classification rather than unconditional validation.

title: Non-Physiological Baseline Equivalence in Clinical VML Prediction
statement: Discrete 3-tier host innervation categories fail to outperform a featureless cohort-mean baseline in out-of-sample LOPO-CV RMSE on authentic human VML data (Dziki et al. 2016).

title: LEFM Keratin Irwin Relation Parameter Degeneracy
statement: Pangolin Keratin fracture toughness K1c = sqrt(E*Gc) represents verification of the LEFM Irwin identity rather than an independent holdout material prediction.

title: Extreme Psychrometric Vapor Pressure Ceiling in Uncompensable Heat Stress
statement: Evaporative heat loss capacity under protective armor drops by >50% between 50% RH and 80% RH at 35C, making 80% RH comparisons to Montain et al. (1994) physically invalid.

title: Microvascular Canal Compressive Strength Tradeoff in Living Osteoderms
statement: Metabolic perfusion of endogenous dermal armor requires vascular canals that reduce solid load-bearing fraction by 20-35%, limiting compressive yield strength below 200 MPa.

title: Interfacial Shear Fatigue and Debris Osteolysis in Subdermal Biohybrids
statement: Subdermal synthetic ceramic/polymeric armor micro-tiles experience interfacial shear stresses > 5 MPa during cutting maneuvers, causing fatigue loosening within 10^6 cycles.

title: Synkinetic Pathfinding and Neuromuscular Transmission Limits in Massive VML
statement: Functional contractile force recovery in large VML defects is bottlenecked by aberrant poly-innervation and failed neuromuscular junction maturation rather than myofiber cross-sectional area.

title: Satellite Cell Hayflick Exhaustion Under Repeated Muscle Regeneration Cycles
statement: Constitutive regeneration over repeated severe volumetric muscle injuries causes Pax7+ stem cell senescence and progressive fibro-adipogenic substitution within 3-5 cycles. (Rectified in Cycle 6: Limit applies under unremitting dystrophic stress; healthy asymmetric division preserves pool).

title: Viscoelastic-Hydration Scaling of Biological Alpha/Beta Keratins
statement: Natural keratin protective structures obey water-plasticized hydrogen bond disruption and logarithmic strain-rate hardening, allowing accurate modulus prediction across diverse species.

title: Lateral Force Transmission Disruption in Volumetric Muscle Loss
statement: Contractile recovery after VML is bounded primarily by perilesional myofascial force transmission loss and vascular perfusion limits, rendering ECM scaffold alone ineffective without motor reinnervation and mechanical loading.

title: Thermal Nodal Superiority Under Uncompensable Encapsulated Heat Strain
statement: A 3-node dynamic thermal model significantly reduces rectal temperature prediction error relative to a 1-node lumped baseline under matched Montain 1994 conditions.

title: Zero Metabolic Overhead of Subcutaneous Synthetic Biohybrids
statement: Indwelling synthetic armor implants operate with zero ongoing metabolic energy or immune maintenance cost.

title: Microstructural Lamellar Scaling Factor for Cross-Material Keratin Transfer
statement: Direct cross-material transfer of horn-calibrated modulus to pangolin scales fails (error > 80%) unless scaled by a structural lamellar packing parameter Phi_lamellar ~ 0.45.

title: Multi-Study Invariance of Mechanistic VML Functional Recovery Model
statement: A mechanistic VML force recovery model incorporating lateral myofascial shear transmission loss maintains an MAE < 7.0% across independent rodent and porcine studies under Leave-One-Study-Out cross-validation.

title: Thermal Nodal Indistinguishability Under Authentic 2.2 m/s Wind Speed
statement: Under authentic Montain 1994 uncompensable heat stress conditions (wind speed 2.2 m/s), core heating rate differences between 1-node and 3-node models are smaller than physiological inter-subject measurement uncertainty.

title: Microarchitecture-Governed Composite Transfer of Keratin Stiffness Across Divergent Taxonomic Structures
statement: A micromechanical composite model incorporating measured intermediate filament fraction (phi_if), classical laminate layup factors (eta), and tubule porosity (p) predicts hydration-dependent stiffness across horn, hoof, and pangolin scale without post-hoc scaling factors.

title: Cellular Microbuckling and Porosity Scaling Across Ruminant Horn Keratins
statement: Hydrated keratinous tissues experience severe compressive modulus reduction because the water-softened amorphous protein matrix permits lamellar microbuckling under axial load; incorporating matrix-softening and porosity scaling explains holdout variation without overpredicting hydrated modulus.

title: Bovid Horn Hydration-Softening Model Transferability Across True Independent Holdouts
statement: The Hill-type matrix softening and microbuckling model calibrated in Cycle 9 transfers to unseen bovid horn sheaths (Bos taurus) with positive error reduction over the naive baseline (MAE < 0.50 GPa), but fails on ungulate hoof wall without macromolecular crosslink scaling.
